job.title: Senior IT Network Engineer - Juniper Networks
job.description:
About MatchTraceConnect:
MatchTraceConnect is one of Asia’s leading recruitment agencies, specializing in connecting top IT talent with some of the most established system integrators and technology providers across the region. Our client network includes international vendors and large-scale integrators across Thailand, Singapore, and beyond.
About Our Client:
Our client is a well-known and reputable IT integrator headquartered in Bangkok with multiple offices across Asia. The company supports a broad range of enterprise and public-sector clients — including commercial organizations, financial institutions, and government entities. With a strong reputation for quality and long-term partnerships, this organization provides end-to-end IT infrastructure solutions covering network design, implementation, and managed services.
Position Overview:
We are currently seeking a Juniper Network Engineer with a strong hands-on background and a passion for high-performance network environments. The ideal candidate brings a mix of technical expertise, customer-facing experience, and the ability to design, implement, and optimize Juniper-based network infrastructures.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, configure, and implement Juniper-based network solutions for enterprise customers.
  • Support existing environments, ensuring performance, stability, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with clients to assess requirements, propose solutions, and ensure seamless deployment.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex networking issues in production environments.
  • Maintain accurate documentation including network diagrams, configurations, and design reports.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate network infrastructure with security, cloud, and data center technologies.

Qualifications & Experience:
  • 2–4 years of professional experience as a Network Engineer, ideally within a system integrator or service provider environment.
  • Strong technical expertise with Juniper Networks technologies (e.g., MX, EX, SRX Series).
  • Solid understanding of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPNs) and network security concepts.
  • Hands-on configuration experience with JunOS and related tools.
  • Juniper certifications such as JNCIA, JNCIS, or JNCIP are a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive, customer-oriented mindset.

Why Join This Company:
  • Work with one of the most respected IT integrators in Thailand.
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale enterprise and public-sector projects.
  • Continuous training and certification support on Juniper and other advanced technologies.
  • Collaborative, multicultural team environment with career growth opportunities.

Ready to take the next step?
If you’re a motivated Network Engineer passionate about Juniper technologies and eager to grow in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply today.

APPLY NOW
Join a team that builds the backbone of Thailands digital infrastructure.

job.title: Information Security Consultant - Bangkok
job.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough security assessments and audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and threats to information systems.
  • Develop and implement effective security policies, procedures, and controls to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data.
  • Provide expert guidance on security architecture and the deployment of security technologies.
  • Monitor and analyze security incidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
  • Perform risk assessments and develop risk mitigation strategies tailored to the specific needs of each client.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct security awareness training for clients to promote best practices and enhance overall security posture.
  • Collaborate with IT teams, management, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of security measures.
  • Prepare detailed reports and presentations to communicate findings, recommendations, and progress to clients and management.
  • Assist in the development and execution of incident response plans and disaster recovery strategies.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or similar are highly desirable.
  • Proven experience as an Information Security Consultant or in a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, standards, and regulations (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
  • Experience with security technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and encryption tools.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience in conducting security training and awareness programs is a plus.

job.title: Legal Consultant
job.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Client Engagements: Manage and oversee multiple client engagements, acting as a trusted business advisor and providing comprehensive legal counsel.
  • Mentorship and Development: Supervise junior employees, aiding in their appraisal, development, and training to ensure their professional growth.
  • Legal Research and Advisory: Conduct thorough research and write detailed client advice on both domestic and international legal matters, including intellectual property, employment law, and other relevant issues.
  • Technical Developments: Stay abreast of legal and technical developments, and effectively communicate their implications to clients, ensuring they are well-informed on how these changes affect their legal standing.
  • Business Development: Assist with business development efforts, aiming to expand services for existing clients and attract new clients through strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborative Work: Work collaboratively with other practice groups within the legal team and the broader firm to provide integrated and comprehensive legal solutions.

Qualifications:
  • Proven experience as a Legal Consultant or in a similar legal advisory role.
  • Extensive knowledge of domestic and international law, including intellectual property and employment matters.
  • Strong research, writing, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously and work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Relevant legal qualifications (e.g., JD, LLM) and bar admission in the relevant jurisdiction are highly desirable.

Why Join our Client:
  • Join a forward-thinking team dedicated to excellence in legal advisory services.
  • Engage in challenging projects that leverage your legal expertise and expand your professional capabilities.
  • Benefit from opportunities for career growth and professional development within a dynamic organization.

Application Process:
If you are an experienced and driven Legal Consultant looking for an exciting opportunity to advance your career, we encourage you to apply.
